wiki.title: María Elena Durazo
wiki.extract: María Elena Durazo (born March 20, 1953) is an American politician serving in the California State Senate. A Democrat, from 2018 to 2022 she represented the 24th State Senatorial district and has been representing the 26th district since 2022 which encompasses Central Los Angeles, Northeast Los Angeles, East Los Angeles, and Vernon.
